cells.gaps: No source found says whether Law 6/2022 provides for a biometric register, an identity number unique to each person or an identity that can be checked electronically.
cells.note: Stage 3: the ICT regulator's May 2025 framework lists Law 6/2022, the legal regime for civil identification and the citizen identity card, among the laws in force (MOZ-002); it is the 2022 bill, enacted. Nothing held says what the law provides, so not 4.
